\begin{aligned}BC & =\begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 & -1 \\ -3 & 1 & 4\end{bmatrix}\,\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}2\cdot 1+0\cdot (-1)+(-1)\cdot 2 \\ (-3)\cdot 1+1\cdot (-1)+4\cdot 2\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we multiply $A$ by $BC:$

$$
\begin{aligned}ABC & =A(BC) \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & -4 \\ 3 & 2 \\ -2 & 5\end{bmatrix}\,\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 4\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}1\cdot 0+(-4)\cdot 4 \\ 3\cdot 0+2\cdot 4 \\ (-2)\cdot 0+5\cdot 4\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-16 \\ 8 \\ 20\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$
